quotations.old_english: Ðæt áhrérede mód mid ðǽre gesceádlican andsuare bið getǽsed

definitions.meaning: rational, based on reason or argument

quotations.old_english: Is þis wundorlic and winsum and ge-sceádlic (gesceádwíslic, v.l.) spell
quotations.latin: fulcrum hoc atque pretiosum, sive GREEK, sive corollarium vocari mavis

source_text: ge-sceádlic; adj. I. reasonable, suitable :-- Gyf þing gesceádlic swá gyrnþ si res rationabilis ita exigerit, Angl. xiii. 374, 130. Ðæt áhrérede mód mid ðǽre gesceádlican andsuare bið getǽsed commotae mentes responsorum ratione tanguntur, Past. 297, 17. II. rational, based on reason or argument :-- Is þis wundorlic and winsum and ge-sceádlic (gesceádwíslic, v.l.) spell fulcrum hoc atque pretiosum, sive GREEK, sive corollarium vocari mavis, Bt. 34, 5; F. 140, 10. v. un-gesceádlic, and next word.
